By playing with the delicate balance between light and shadow, Komatsu invites the viewer to experience a visual symphony of movement. His intricate sculptures hang suspended in space, where each turn of the mobile reflects a poetic interplay of air and light, evoking a sense of freedom and harmony. A master of minimalist expression, Komatsu creates an immersive environment where the work evolves in response to its surroundings, inviting introspection and connection to the elemental forces of nature.
